en: Begin each run with extra Caps from your stockpile.
zh: 每场冒险开局时从储备中获得额外瓶盖。

en: Carry more loot out of the wasteland — adds backpack cells.
zh: 从废土带走更多战利品——增加背包格子。

en: Carry reroll tokens that re-roll a reward card draft.
zh: 携带刷新令牌，可重掷奖励卡牌的选项。

en: Protect more backpack cells when a run ends in defeat.
zh: 战败时保住更多背包格子。

en: Carry more one-use tools into the wasteland.
zh: 携带更多一次性工具进入荒野。
